title: Contracted product presentation for Zariski change of coefficients
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G,G'$ abelian sheaves on its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], $\varphi:G\to G'$ a morphism, and $T,T'$ torsors under $G,G'$ respectively [def-sc-gm-torsor]. A Zariski contracted product presentation of $T'$ consists of natural maps $q_U:T(U)\times G'(U)\to T'(U)$, invariant under $(t,h)\mapsto(g\cdot t,h-\varphi_U(g))$ and satisfying $q_U(t,h+k)=k\cdot q_U(t,h)$. Every natural invariant family $a_U:T(U)\times G'(U)\to F(U)$ into any sheaf of sets $F$ factors uniquely through a sheaf morphism $l:T'\to F$. This specifies the sheafification of the orbit presheaf $(T\times G')/G$, with residual $G'$-translation on the second factor.
